//: Tasks source for Windows-host tooling. Run 'uv run python scripts/check_tasks_json.py' after editing tasks to verify screen error visibility contracts.

tasks.command: npm install
tasks.label: Initial Setup

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run -q --with ruff ruff check --config pyproject.toml --exit-zero . 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/ruff_lint.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/ruff_lint.txt 'All checks passed' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet 'All checks passed' .reports/ruff_lint.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $passed -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/ruff_lint.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  Ruff Lint: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Ruff Lint: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }
tasks.label: Validate: Ruff Lint

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run -q --with ruff ruff format --config pyproject.toml --check . 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/ruff_format_status.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/ruff_format_status.txt '36 files already formatted' }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/ruff_format_status.txt)') } } } else { $summaryLine = if ($out -is [array]) { $out[-1] } else { $out }; if ($summaryLine) { Write-Host ('  ' + $summaryLine) } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Write-Host '✔  Ruff Format: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Ruff Format: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Validate: Ruff Format Check

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = npx -q prettier --config .validate/.prettierrc.json --ignore-path .gitignore --ignore-path .validate/.prettierignore --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --check '**/*.json' '**/*.yaml' '!.validate/**' '!node_modules/**' 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/prettier_check.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/prettier_check.txt 'All matched files use Prettier code style!' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet -Pattern 'Prettier code style', 'All matched files use Prettier code style' .reports/prettier_check.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $passed -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/prettier_check.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  Prettier: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Prettier: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Validate: Prettier Check

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = npx -q --package=markdownlint-cli markdownlint --config .validate/.markdownlint.json --ignore-path .gitignore '**/*.md' 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($ec -eq 0) { Set-Content .reports/markdown_lint.txt '' } else { $out | Set-Content .reports/markdown_lint.txt }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/markdown_lint.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Write-Host '✔  Markdown Lint: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Markdown Lint: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Validate: Markdown Style

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $null = git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $f = git ls-files -- '*.yaml' '*.yml' 2>$null; if ($f) { $out = uv run -q --with yamllint yamllint -c .validate/.yamllint $f 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($ec -eq 0) { Set-Content .reports/yaml_lint.txt '' } else { $out | Set-Content .reports/yaml_lint.txt } } else { $ec = 0; Set-Content .reports/yaml_lint.txt ''; Write-Host 'No tracked YAML files.' } } else { $out = uv run -q --with yamllint yamllint -c .validate/.yamllint . 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($ec -eq 0) { Set-Content .reports/yaml_lint.txt '' } else { $out | Set-Content .reports/yaml_lint.txt } }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/yaml_lint.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Write-Host '✔  YAML Lint: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  YAML Lint: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Validate: YAML Style

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run -q --with codespell codespell . 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($ec -eq 0) { Set-Content .reports/codespell.txt '' } else { $out | Set-Content .reports/codespell.txt }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/codespell.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Write-Host '✔  Codespell: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Codespell: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Validate: Codespell

tasks.command: python .workbench/validate_files.py '${relativeFile}'
tasks.label: Validate: This File

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports; if (Test-Path .github) { uv run -q --with zizmor zizmor --pedantic .github/ | tee .reports/zizmor_audit.txt; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($ec -eq 0) { Add-Content .reports/zizmor_audit.txt '✔  Zizmor Audit: PASSED' } } else { Set-Content .reports/zizmor_audit.txt '–  Skipped: no .github/ workflows'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no .github/ workflows' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.label: Validate: Zizmor

tasks.command: python .workbench/psscriptanalyzer_retry.py check
tasks.label: Validate: PSScriptAnalyzer

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; if (Test-Path tests) { $cov = @(); if (Test-Path workbench) { $cov += '--cov=workbench' }; if (Test-Path scripts) { $cov += '--cov=scripts' }; if ($cov.Count -eq 0) { $cov = @('--cov') }; $out = uv run pytest --color=yes $cov --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100 --cov-report=term-missing 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; $clean = $out -replace '\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]', ''; $clean | Set-Content .reports/coverage.txt; $out | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Write-Host '✔  Pytest Coverage: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Pytest Coverage: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/coverage.txt '–  Skipped: no tests/ folder'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no tests/ folder' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.label: Validate: Pytest Coverage

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_queue_format.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_queue_format.py 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/queue_format.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/queue_format.txt 'Queue Format: PASSED' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet 'Queue Format: PASSED' .reports/queue_format.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($out) { if ($passed) { $out | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\(Advisory:' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ -ForegroundColor Yellow } } else { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/queue_format.txt)') } } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  Queue Format: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Queue Format: FINDINGS (report-only)' -ForegroundColor Yellow } } else { Set-Content .reports/queue_format.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_queue_format.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_queue_format.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.detail: Validates the cross-project x_project/ queue and, with --project, one project's .notes/tasks/. Checks the status vocabulary, the Verified date, the Start here line, evidence on settled cells and stamps on archived ones. Report-only: prints a yellow banner on findings and always exits 0, so it never aborts Validate All.
tasks.label: Env: Check Queue Format

tasks.command: if (Test-Path workbench/generate_roadmap.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python workbench/generate_roadmap.py --check 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/roadmap_check.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/roadmap_check.txt 'Roadmaps: all up to date' }; if ($ec -eq 0) { Write-Host '✔  Roadmap Check: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/roadmap_check.txt)') } }; Write-Host; Write-Host '✖  Roadmap Check: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/roadmap_check.txt '–  Skipped: no workbench/generate_roadmap.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no workbench/generate_roadmap.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.detail: Runs workbench/generate_roadmap.py --check across projects to detect roadmap drift from task queues.
tasks.label: Roadmap: Generate & Check

tasks.command: uv run python workbench/generate_roadmap.py; Write-Host '✔  Generate All Roadmaps: COMPLETED' -ForegroundColor Green
tasks.detail: Manual generator for all project ROADMAP.md files from task queues. Not part of validation suites.
tasks.label: Fix: Generate All Roadmaps

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_release_plan.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_release_plan.py --all 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/release_plans.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/release_plans.txt 'Release Plan Check: PASSED' }; if ($out) { $out | Where-Object { $_ -match 'status `|error\(s\)' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }; Write-Host; if (Select-String -Quiet 'Release Plan Check: PASSED' .reports/release_plans.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host '✔  Release Plan Check: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Release Plan Check: FINDINGS (report-only)' -ForegroundColor Yellow } } else { Set-Content .reports/release_plans.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_release_plan.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_release_plan.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.detail: Checks every plan under shared/ProjNotes/*/issues/plans_status/ that carries the release plan template marker, against release_plan_guide.md: sections and notes, IDs and links, dispositions, item fields, and the release gate. Plans without the marker are skipped. Report-only: prints a yellow banner on findings and always exits 0, so it never aborts Validate All.
tasks.label: Env: Check Release Plans

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_prompts.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_prompts.py 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/prompt_check.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/prompt_check.txt 'Prompt Check: PASSED' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet 'Prompt Check: PASSED' .reports/prompt_check.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($out) { if ($passed) { $out | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\(Advisory:' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ -ForegroundColor Yellow } } else { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/prompt_check.txt)') } } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  Prompt Check: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } elseif (Select-String -Quiet 'Prompt Check: SKIPPED' .reports/prompt_check.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host '–  Prompt Check: SKIPPED' -ForegroundColor Cyan } else { Write-Host '✖  Prompt Check: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/prompt_check.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_prompts.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_prompts.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.label: Env: Check Shared Prompts

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_prompt_cadence.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_prompt_cadence.py 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/prompt_cadence.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/prompt_cadence.txt 'Prompts Overdue & Due Check: PASSED' }; if ($out) { $out | Select-String -Pattern '^\s*-\s+\*\*(Total Targets|Overdue Targets|Due Targets|Never Run|Current Targets)' | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.Line } }; Write-Host; if (Select-String -Quiet 'Prompts Overdue & Due Check' .reports/prompt_cadence.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host '✔  Prompt Cadence: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Prompt Cadence: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/prompt_cadence.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_prompt_cadence.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_prompt_cadence.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.label: Env: Check Prompt Cadence

tasks.command: if (Test-Path workbench/check_sensor_manifest.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue .reports/sensor_manifest.txt; $failed = $false; foreach ($proj in @('huawei', 'zte', 'unifi', 'wifi')) { $out = uv run python workbench/check_sensor_manifest.py $proj --check 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Add-Content .reports/sensor_manifest.txt; Write-Host $out }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failed = $true } }; Write-Host; if (-not $failed) { Write-Host '✔  Sensor Manifest: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Sensor Manifest: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/sensor_manifest.txt '–  Skipped: no workbench/check_sensor_manifest.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no workbench/check_sensor_manifest.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.label: Env: Check Sensor Manifest

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_changelog_header.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_changelog_header.py 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/changelog_header.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/changelog_header.txt 'Changelog Header: PASSED' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet 'carry the canonical Authoring Rules block' .reports/changelog_header.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($out) { if ($passed) { $out | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(Total files checked:|\[OK\]|Summary:)' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } } else { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/changelog_header.txt)') } } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  Changelog Headers: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Changelog Headers: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/changelog_header.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_changelog_header.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_changelog_header.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_agents_md.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_agents_md.py 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/agents_md.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/agents_md.txt 'AGENTS.md Audit: PASSED' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet 'match canonical structure and boilerplate rules' .reports/agents_md.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($out) { if ($passed) { $out | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(Total files checked:|\[OK\]|Summary:)' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } } else { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/agents_md.txt)') } } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  AGENTS.md Audit: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  AGENTS.md Audit: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/agents_md.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_agents_md.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_agents_md.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_local_leaks.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_local_leaks.py 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/local_leaks.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/local_leaks.txt 'Local Leak Check: FAILED (no output)' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet 'Local Leak Check: PASSED' .reports/local_leaks.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/local_leaks.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  Local Leak Check: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } elseif (Select-String -Quiet 'Local Leak Check: SKIPPED' .reports/local_leaks.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host '–  Local Leak Check: SKIPPED (no denylist)' -ForegroundColor Cyan } else { Write-Host '✖  Local Leak Check: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/local_leaks.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_local_leaks.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_local_leaks.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0
tasks.detail: Scans every repository in the workspace for real deployment values listed in shared/ProjNotes/Notes-dev-workbench/local_only/leak_denylist.txt. Findings print masked. The list stays in local_only/ because a tracked copy would publish it. Standard placeholders: shared/SharedNotes/dev_std/example_values.md. Report-only: always exits 0, so it never aborts Validate All.
tasks.label: Env: Check Local Leaks

tasks.command: if (Test-Path scripts/check_suppressions.py) { mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run python scripts/check_suppressions.py --summary 2>&1; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/check_suppressions.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/check_suppressions.txt 'Pragma Suppression Check: FAILED (no output)' }; $passed = Select-String -Quiet 'Pragma Suppression Check: PASSED' .reports/check_suppressions.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $hasAdvisory = Select-String -Quiet 'ADVISORY WARNING:' .reports/check_suppressions.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/check_suppressions.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($passed -and $hasAdvisory) { Write-Host '⚠  Suppression Check: ADVISORY (unvetted suppressions)' -ForegroundColor Yellow } elseif ($passed) { Write-Host '✔  Suppression Check: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Suppression Check: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Set-Content .reports/check_suppressions.txt '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_suppressions.py'; Write-Host '–  Skipped: no scripts/check_suppressions.py' -ForegroundColor Cyan }; exit 0

tasks.detail: Offline check of host tools: pinned npm and .venv packages against workbench/matrix/version_matrix.json, and the age of the Update_Host_Tools.ps1 -Update record. Writes .reports/host_tools.txt. Report-only: always exits 0, so it never aborts Validate All.

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run -q --with ruff ruff check --config pyproject.toml --fix . 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/format_ruff_lint.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/format_ruff_lint.txt 'All checks passed' }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/format_ruff_lint.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Add-Content .reports/format_ruff_lint.txt '✔  Ruff Lint Fix: PASSED'; Write-Host '✔  Ruff Lint Fix: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Ruff Lint Fix: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Format: Apply Ruff Lint Fix

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run -q --with ruff ruff format --config pyproject.toml . 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/format_ruff.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/format_ruff.txt '36 files left unchanged' }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/format_ruff.txt)') } } } else { $summaryLine = if ($out -is [array]) { $out[-1] } else { $out }; if ($summaryLine) { Write-Host ('  ' + $summaryLine) } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Add-Content .reports/format_ruff.txt '✔  Ruff Format Fix: PASSED'; Write-Host '✔  Ruff Format Fix: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Ruff Format Fix: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Format: Apply Ruff Format

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = npx -q prettier --config .validate/.prettierrc.json --ignore-path .gitignore --ignore-path .validate/.prettierignore --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --write '**/*.json' '**/*.yaml' '!.validate/**' '!node_modules/**' 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; $clean = if ($out) { $out -replace '\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]', '' } else { 'unchanged' }; $clean | Set-Content .reports/format_prettier.txt; if ($clean -and $clean -notmatch '^\s*unchanged\s*$') { $errs = @($clean | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -and $_ -notmatch 'PASSED|FAILED' }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/format_prettier.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Add-Content .reports/format_prettier.txt '✔  Prettier Format: PASSED'; Write-Host '✔  Prettier Format: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Prettier Format: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Format: Apply Prettier

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = uv run -q --with codespell codespell -w . 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/format_codespell.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/format_codespell.txt '' }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/format_codespell.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Add-Content .reports/format_codespell.txt '✔  Codespell Fix: PASSED'; Write-Host '✔  Codespell Fix: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Codespell Fix: FAILED' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
tasks.label: Format: Apply Codespell

tasks.command: mkdir -Force .reports | Out-Null; $out = npx -q --package=markdownlint-cli markdownlint --config .validate/.markdownlint.json --ignore-path .gitignore --fix '**/*.md' 2>&1; $ec = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($out) { $out | Set-Content .reports/format_markdownlint.txt } else { Set-Content .reports/format_markdownlint.txt '' }; if ($ec -ne 0 -and $out) { $errs = @($out | Out-String -Stream | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }); if ($errs) { $errs | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('  ' + $_) }; if ($errs.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ('  ... and ' + ($errs.Count - 20) + ' more lines (see .reports/format_markdownlint.txt)') } } }; Write-Host; if ($ec -eq 0) { Add-Content .reports/format_markdownlint.txt '✔  Markdownlint Fix: PASSED'; Write-Host '✔  Markdownlint Fix: PASSED' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✖  Markdownlint Fix: FAILED (unfixable errors remain — edit manually)' -ForegroundColor Red }; exit 0
